user.title: Astronomy Space Suite
user.description: Set up your space dashboard. All satellite cameras and ISS tracking work without any API key.

data_description.api_key: Enter your NASA API key (get one free at api.nasa.gov).
data_description.rocket_api_key: Optional key for RocketLaunch.Live (leave blank for free tier).

ephemeris.title: Ephemeris — Planetary Positions
ephemeris.description: Configure local ephemeris calculations. All calculations run locally — no external API needed. You can change these later in Options.

data.body_sun: ☀️ Sun — altitude, azimuth, twilight times, solar noon
data.body_moon: 🌙 Moon — altitude, phase, illumination, next full/new moon

data_description.enabled: Enables local ephemeris calculations for selected celestial bodies.
data_description.latitude: Your observation latitude (defaults to Home Assistant home location).
data_description.longitude: Your observation longitude (defaults to Home Assistant home location).
data_description.elevation: Your elevation in meters. Affects rise/set calculations.
data_description.update_interval: How often positions are recalculated (minimum 300s, default 3600s).
data_description.body_sun: Creates sensors for solar position, twilight times, and solar noon.
data_description.body_moon: Creates sensors for lunar position, phase angle, and illumination.
data_description.body_mercury: Creates sensors for Mercury's position and visibility.
data_description.body_venus: Creates sensors for Venus's position and visibility.
data_description.body_mars: Creates sensors for Mars's position and visibility.
data_description.body_jupiter: Creates sensors for Jupiter's position and visibility.
data_description.body_saturn: Creates sensors for Saturn's position and visibility.
data_description.body_uranus: Creates sensors for Uranus's position and visibility.
data_description.body_neptune: Creates sensors for Neptune's position and visibility.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to NASA API — check your network
error.invalid_auth: Invalid NASA API key — verify at api.nasa.gov

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured
